target.validation_method: root SSH target probe; no computer-use visual inspection

build_validation.host_and_arm_tests: transport control reader, framebuffer scanout RTL, host ABI and Cortex-A9 QEMU checks passed

hardware_validation.clean_boot: Board rebooted, Menu loaded, then verified Diablo RBF loaded; FPGA manager reported operating.
hardware_validation.control_attachment: ARM probe reported epoch 0xd1a61001 and fpga_state=ready.
hardware_validation.frame_one: ARM published slot 0 frame ID 1; FPGA scanout claimed it.
hardware_validation.frame_two: ARM published slot 1 frame ID 2; FPGA scanout claimed it.
hardware_validation.retirement: FPGA reclaimed retired slot 0 only after the scanout safety interval.

scope_limit: This proves ARM-to-FPGA descriptor ownership and scanout handoff on the board. It does not visually certify HDMI output and does not cover real Diablo rendering, audio, input, or performance qualification.
